iterations.description: Number of loops to iterate through. 0 means infinite.

memory.description: Amount of memory to allocate and test. Suffixes B, K, M, G allowed.

phys_addr.description: Physical address (hex) to test using mmap. Empty to use standard malloc/mlock.

device.description: Device path for -p option (e.g., /dev/mem). Default /dev/mem if -p is used.

uncached.description: If true, adds -u flag to use uncached memory semantics.

test_mask.description: Bitmask for MEMTESTER_TEST_MASK env var. Decimal, octal (0...), or hex (0x...) allowed.
